headword: {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}

definitions.gloss: supply shortage; insufficient supply relative to demand
definitions.explanation: A state in which the quantity of goods, materials, or labor available falls short of what buyers want, typically pushing prices up. Standard vocabulary in business news reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半導体|はんどうたい}→半導体：09248_handoutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The semiconductor supply shortage is continuing.

examples.japanese: {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Prices are rising because of the supply shortage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧⟦{不順|ふじゅん}→不順：28203_fujun⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{上|あ}げた→押し上げる：12865_oshiageru⟧。
examples.english: A shortage of vegetables caused by unseasonable weather pushed food prices up.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into a supply shortage
- {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: for a shortage to persist
- {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧: to resolve a shortage
- ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な{供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}: a serious shortage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{品薄|しなうす}→品薄：30618_shinausu⟧: low stock — describes shop shelves, a more everyday word
- ⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧: labor shortage — the same {不足|ぶそく} pattern applied to workers
- ⟦{供給過剰|きょうきゅうかじょう}→供給過剰：22472_kyoukyuukajou⟧: oversupply — the opposite condition
